॥ nAsatyaYcApi me janma tvattaH paYcamamucyate । aRqajaM cApi me janma tvattaH zazWaM vinirmmitam ॥ idaYca saptamaM janma padmajanmeti me praBo ! । sarge sarge hyahaM puttrastava triguRavarjjita ! ॥” iti mahABArate SAntiparvvaRi mokzaDarmme anirudDarUpavizRuM prati pAdmakalpIyabrahmavacanam ॥ * ॥ tasya patanakAlo yaTA, -- “dvAtriMSadabdakowyastu taTA vfndAzwakaM Bavet । KarvvadvayaM niKarvvaYca SaNkutrayayutaM taTA ॥ padmamekaM samudrASca trayo brahmasamAgate । brahmA vizRudine cEkaH patatyevaM vadanti te ॥ manIziRastaTA vizRurahanyuMgrasya SaNkaraH । ISvarasya taTA cAsO sa sAMKyaprakftestaTA ॥ ataH paraM pare DAmni kAlasaMKyA na vidyate । brahmaRo'taH paraM saMKyA nAsti cEtanmataM hi naH ॥” api ca । “ekArRave tu trElokye brahmA nArAyaRAtmakaH । BogiSayyAgataH Sete trElokyagrAsavfMhitaH ॥ jalasTEryogiBirdevaScintyamAno'bjasamBavaH । vyatItAyAntu SarvvaryyAM sa budDvA sfjate punaH ॥ evantu brahmaRo varzaM taTA varzaSataM Bavet । gate varze Sate brahmA paramAtmani lIyate ॥” ityagnipurARam ॥

SfNgArAnte ca tasyAYca vIryyADAnaM mayA kftam । daDAra garBaM sA rADA yAvadbE brahmaRaH Satam ॥ susAva sA tadante ca qimbaM tat paramAdButam । cukopa devI taM dfzwvA ruroda vizasAda sA ॥ pAdena yAvanti lomakUpAni mahAvizRoH krameRa ca । viSvAnyeva hi tAvanti hyasaMKyAni pitarDruvam ॥” iti brahmavEvartte SrIkfzRajanmaKaRqe । 84 । 52-101 ॥ api ca । “devIguRatrayAvizwamaRqaYca kowivistaram । । AraRyAni ca sattvAni sOvarRAni ca kArayet । vfkzAn vanaspatIMScAtra tfRavallIH savIruDaH” । yAdasAni, jalasamBavAni, puzpaPalavanto vfkzAH apuzpAH PalinovanaspatayaH, vIruDogucCagulmAdayaH । “sarvaM prakalpya viDivattIrTe deyaM vicakzaREH । kurukzetre gayAyAM ca prayAge'marakaRWake । dvAravatyAM praBAse ca gaNgAdvAre ca puzkare । tIrTezvetezu vE deyaM grahaRe somasUryyayoH । dimacCedezu sarvezu ayane dakziRottare । vyatIpAte bahuguRaM vizuve ca viSezataH । dAtavyametadrAjendra! vicAraM nEva kArayet । kAlAgnihItriRaM vipraM surUpaYca guRAnvitam । sapatnIkaM ca saMpUjya BUzayitvA viBUzaREH । purohitaM muKyatamaM kftvAnyAMSca taTartvijaH । caturviMSad guRopetAn sapatnIkAnnimantritAn । ahatAmbarasucCannAn sragviRaH suviBUzitAn । aNgulIyakaratnAni karRavezwAMSca dApayet । evaMviDAMSca saMpUjya tezAmagre svayaM sTitaH । azwANgapraRipAtena praRanya ca punaH punaH । purohitAya purataH kftvA vEkarasaMpuwam । yUyaM vE brahmaRA DAtrA, mEtratvenAnugfhyatAm । sOmuKyeneha BavatAmBavet pUtonaraH svayam । BavatAM protiyogena svayaM prItaH pitAmahaH । brahmARqena tu dattena tezAM prIto janArdanaH । pinAkapARirBagavAn SakraSca tridaSeSvaraH । ete vE tozamAyAnti anuDyAtA dvijottamEH । eva stutvA tato rAjA brAhmaRAn vedavAramAn । brahmARqaM gurave prAdAt saviDAnaM punaH punaH । sarvakAmEstatastapto yayO svargaM narADipaH । tenApi guruRA tacca viBaktaM brAhmaREH saha । dattastErapi cAnyeByo brahmARqAMSo narADipa! । brahmARqaM BUmidAnaM ca grAhyaM nEkena tadBavet । gfhRandIzamavApnoti brahmahatyAM na saMSayaH । sarvezAYcEva pratyakzaM dAtavyaM tannarADipa! । dIyamAnaYca paSyanti te'pi pUtA Bavanti hi । darSanAdeva te pUtA BaveyurnAtra saMSayaH” । padmapurARoktastadviDiryaTA “SfRu vatsa! pravakzyAmi brahmARqAKyaM purAtanam । tacca dvAdaSasAhasraM BAvikalpakaTAyutam । prakriyAKyo 1 'nazaNgAKya 2 upodGAta 3 stftIyakaH । caturTa upasaMhAraH 4 pAdAScatvAra eva hi । pUrvapAdadvayaM pUrvo BAgo'tra samudAhftaH । tftIyo maDyamo BAgaScaturTastUttaro mataH । tatra pUrvaBAge prakriyApAde “AdO kftyasamuddeSo nEmizAKyAnakaM tataH । hiraRyagarBotpattiSca lokakalpanameva ca । eza vE praTamaH pAdo dvitIyaM SfRu mAnada” । pUrvaBAge anuzaNgapAde “kalpamanvantarAKyAnaM lokajYAnaM tataH param । mAnasasfzwikaTanaM rudraprasavavarRanam । mahAdevaviBUtiSca fzisargastataHparam । agnInAM vicayaScATa kAlasadBAvavarRanam । priyavratAcayoddeSaH pfTivyAyAmavistaraH । varRanaM BAratasyAsya tatI'nyezAM nirUpaRam । jambvAdisaptadvIpAKyA tato'DIlokavarRanam । UrdDvalokAnukaTanaM grahacArastataHparam । AdityavyUhakaTanaM devagrahAnukIrttanam । nIlakaRWAhvayAKyAnaM mahAdevasya vEmavam । amAvAsyAnukaTanaM yugatattvanirUpaRam । yajYapravarttanaM cATa yugayorantyayoH kftiH । yagaprajAlakzaRaYca fzipravaravarRanam । vedAnAM vyasanAKyAnaM syAyamBuvanirUpaRam । SezamanvantarAKyAnaM pfTivIdohanantataH । cAkzuze'dyatane sargo dvitIyo'NGriH purodale” । maDyaBAge upodGAtipAde “aTopodGAtapAde tu saptarziparikIrttanam । prAjApatyacayastasmAddevAdInAM samudBavaH । tato jayABivyAhArO marudutpattikIrttanam । kASyapeyAnukaTanam fzivaMSanirUpaRam । pitfkalpAnukaTanaM SrAdDakalpastataHparam । vEvasvatasamutpattiH sfzwistasya tataH param । manuputrAcayaScAto gAnDarvasya nirUpaRam । ikzvAkuvaMSakaTanaM vaMSo'treH sumahAtmanaH । amAvasorAcayaSca rajeScaritamadButam । yayAticaritaYcATa yaduvaMSanirUpaRam । kArttavIryyasya caritaM jAmadagnyaM tataH param । kfzRivaMSAnukaTanaM sagarasyATa samBavaH । BArgavasyAnucaritaM taTAryyakabaDASrayam । sagarasyATa caritaM BArgavasya kaTA punaH । devAsurAhavakaTA kfzRAvirBAvavarRanam । inasya ca stavaH puRyaH SukreRa parikIrttitaH । vizRumAhAtmyakaTanaM balivaMSanirUpaRam । BavizyarAjacaritaM saMprApte'Ta kalO yuge । evamuddvAtapAdA'yaM tftoyo maDyame dale” । uttaraBAge upasaMhArapAde “caturTamupasaMhAraM vakzye KaRqe taTottare । vEvasvatAntarAKyAnaM vistareRa yaTAtaTam । pUrvameva samuddizwaM saMkzepAdiha kaTyate । BavizyARAM manUnAYca caritaM hi tataH param । kalpapralayanirdeSaH kAlamAnaM tataH param । lokAScaturdaSa tataH kaTitA mAnalakzaREH । varRanaM narakARAYca vikarmAcaraREstataH । manImayapurAKyAnaM layaH prAkftikastataH । SEvasyATa purasyApi varRanaYca tataH param । triviDAdguRasambanDAjjantUnAM kIrttitA gatiH । anirdeSyApratarkasya brahmaRaH paramAtmanaH । anvayavyatirekAByAM varRanaM hi tataH param । ityeza upasaMhAraH pAdo vfttaH sa cottaraH । catuzpAdaM purARaM te brahmARqaM samudAhftam । azwAdaSamanOpamyaM sArAt sArataraM dvija! । brahmARqaYca caturlakzaM purARatvena paWyate । tadeva vyasya gaditamatrAzwAdaSaDA pfTak । pArASaryyeRa muninA sarvezAmapi mAnada! । vastudrazwrATa tenEva munInAM BAvitAtmanAm । mattaH SrutvA purARAni lokeByaH pracakASire । munayo DarmaSIlAste dInAnugrahakAriRaH । mayA cedaM purARantu vaSizWAya puroditam । tena SaktisutAyoktaM jAtUkarRAya tena ca । vyAso labDvA tataScEtat pramaYcanamuKodgatam । pramARImatya loke'smin prAvarttayadanuttamam” । tatPalaSrutiH “ya idaM kIrttayedvatsa! SfRoti ca samAhitaH । sa viDUyeha pApAni yAti lokamanAmayam । liKitvEtat purARantu svarRasiMhAsanasTitam । pAtreRAcCAditaM yastu brahmaRAya prayacCati । sa yAti brahmaRA lokaM nAtra kAryyA vicAraRA । marIce! 'zwAdaSEtAni mayA proktAni yAni te । purARAni tu sakzepAcCrotavyAni ca vistarAt । azwAdaSa purARAni yaH SfRoti narottamaH । kaTayedvA viDAnena neha BUyaH sa jAyate । sUtrametat purARAnAM yanmayoktaM tavADunA । tannityaM SIlanIyaM hi purARaPalamicCatA । na dAmBikAya pApAya devagurvanusUyave । deyaM kadApi sADUnAM dveziRe na SaWAya ca । SAntAya rAgicittAya SrUSruzABiratAya ca । nirsatsarAya Sucaye deya sadvEzRavAya ca” nAradIyapu॰ 4 pA॰ 109 a॰ ।

s: klI, (brahmEvArpaRamitivigrahe yadarpaRaM tadbrahmEva । yaTA, gItAyAm । 4 । 24 ॥ “brahmArpaRaM brahmahavirbrahmAgnO brahmaRAhutam ॥” “brahmArpaRaM yena karaRena prakAreRa brahmavidBiragnAvarpayati tadbrahmEveti paSyati tasyAtmavyatirekeRABAvaM paSyati yaTA SuktikAyAM rajatABAvaM paSyati tadbaduvyate brahmEvArpaRamiti yaTA yadrajataM tacCuktikEveti । brahma arpaRamityasamaste pade yadarpaRabudDyA gfhyate loke tadasya brahmavido brahmEvetyarTaH । iti SANkaraBAzyam ॥) brahmaRi samarpaRam । tatprakArA yaTA, “brahmaRA dIyate deyaM brahmaRe saMpradIyate । brahmEva dIyate ceti brahmArpaRamidaM param ॥ nAhaM karttA sarvvametadbrahmEva kurute taTA । etad brahmArpaRaM proktaM fziBistattvadarSiBiH ॥ prIRAtu BagavAnISaH karmmaRAnena SASvataH । karoti satataM budDyA brahmArpaRamidaM param ॥ yadvA PalAnAM saMnyAsaM prakuryyAt parameSvare । karmmaRAmetadapyAhurbrahmArpaRamanuttamam ॥” iti kUrmmapurARe 4 aDyAyaH ॥

parastrIvarjanaparastasyopasTaM susaMyatam । alolupo mitaM BuNkte jaWaraM tasya saMyatam ॥ satyaM hitaM mitaM brUte yaH sadA tasya vAg yatA । yasya saMyatAnyetAni tasya kiM tapasADvarEH ॥ EkyaM yadbudDimanasorindriyARAYca sarvvadA । viSveSvare pare deve DyAnametat prakIrttitam ॥ BruvormaDye sTitAM budDiM vizayezu yunakti yaH । jIvo jAgradavasTAyAmevamAhurvipaScitaH ॥ indriyARAmuparame manasi hyavyavasTite । svapnAn paSyatyasO jIvo vAhyAnAByantarAnaTa ॥ hfdi sTitaH sa tamasA mohito na smaratyapi । yadA kasya kuto vetti susuptiriti kaTyate ॥ jAgrato yasya no tandrIrna moho na BramastaTA । utpadyate na jAnAti SabdAdivizayAn vaSI ॥ indriyARi samAhftya vizayeByo manastaTA । budDyAhaNkAramapi ca prakftyA budDimeva ca ॥ saMyamya prakftiYcApi cicCaktyA kevale sTitaH । paSyatyAtmani cAtmAnamAtmanAtmaprakASakam ॥ cidrUpamamftaM SudDaM nizkriyaM vyApakaM Sivam । turIyAyAmavasTAyAmAsTito'sO na saMSayaH ॥ SabdAdayo guRAH paYca sattvAdyAstu guRAstrayaH । puryyazwakasya padmasya patrARyazwO ca tAni hi ॥ sAmyAvasTA guRakftA prakftistatra karRikA । karRikAyAM sTito jIvo dehe cidrUpa eva hi ॥ puryyazwakaM parityajya prakftiYca guRAtmikAm । yadA yAti tadA jIvo yAti muktiM na saMSayaH । SarIreRa caturBAgaH karmma budDIndriyARi ca । tripaYcakaM vinaSyeta yAti puryyazwakaM sadA । sanDAryyaYcEva jIvena yogasevI hi muktiBAk ॥ prARAyAmo japaScEva pratyAhAro'Ta DAraRA । DyAnaM samADirityete zaqyogasya prasADakAH ॥ pApakzayo devatAnAM prItirindriyasaMyamaH । manasaH sTiratA teByastattvAlokaSca sarvvadA ॥ gAyattryA praRavenATa mAtrayA prARasaMyamaH । japaDyAnayuto garBastena hInastvagarBakaH ॥ zawtriMSanmAtrikaH SrezWaScaturviMSatimAtrikaH । maDyA dvAdaSamAtrAstu o~kAraM satataM japet ॥ SrutvA yaTAsvaraM samyak SabdaM gOryAti saMmuKI । praRave ca kfte tadvat paraM brahma na saMSayaH ॥ cArake praRave japte paraM brahma prasIdati । azwAkzaraSca japtavyo gAyattrI dvAdaSAkzarA ॥ sarvvezAmindriyARAntu pravfttirvizayezu yA । nivfttirmanasA tasyAM pratyAhAraH prakIrttitaH ॥ indriyARIndriyArTeBya samAhftya sTito hi saH । manasA saha budDyA ca pratyAhArezu saMsTitaH ॥ prARAyAmErdvAdaSaBiryAvat kAlakfto Bavet । yastAvat kAlaparyyantaM mano brahmaRi DArayet ॥ tasyEva DyeyastallayatAM gataH । paSyati dvEtarahitaM samADiH so'BiDIyate ॥ manaH saMkalparahitamindriyArTAMstu cintayan । yasya brahmaRi saMlInaM samADisTaH sa kIttitaH ॥ DyAyataH paramAtmAnamAtmasTaM yasya yoginaH । manastallayatAM yAti samADisTaH sa kIrttitaH ॥ citrasyAsTiratA BrAntidOrmanasyaM pramAdatA । yoginAM kaTitA dozA yogaviGnapravarttakAH ॥ sTityarTaM manasaH sarvvaM sTUlarUpaM vicintayet । m: ब्रह्मन् n. (lit. ‘growth’, ‘expansion’, ‘evolution’, ‘development’ ‘swelling of the spirit or soul’, fr. √ 2. बृह्) pious effusion or utterance, outpouring of the heart in worshipping the gods, prayer, RV.; AV.; VS.; TS.

the sacred word (as opp. to वाच्, the word of man), the Veda, a sacred text, a text or Mantra used as a spell (forming a distinct class from the ऋचस्, सामानि and यजूंषि; cf. ब्रह्म-वेद), RV.; AV.; Br.; Mn.; Pur.
the Brāhmaṇa portion of the Veda, Mn. iv, 100
the sacred syllable Om, Prab., Sch., (cf. Mn. ii, 83)
religious or spiritual knowledge (opp. to religious observances and bodily mortification such as तपस् &c.), AV.; Br.; Mn.; R.
holy life (esp. continence, chastity; cf. ब्रह्म-चर्य), Śak. i, 24/25; Śaṃk.; Sarvad.

(exceptionally treated as m.) the Brahmă or one self-existent impersonal Spirit, the one universal Soul (or one divine essence and source from which all created things emanate or with which they are identified and to which they return), the Self-existent, the Absolute, the Eternal (not generally an object of worship but rather of meditation and-knowledge ; also with ज्येष्ठ, प्रथम-ज, स्वयम्-भु, अ-मूर्त, पर, परतर, परम, महत्, सनातन, शाश्वत; and = परमात्मन्, आत्मन्, अध्यात्म, प्रधान, क्षेत्र-ज्ञ, तत्त्व), AV.; ŚBr.; Mn.; MBh. &c. (IW. 9, 83 &c.)
ब्रह्मन् n. the class of men who are the repositories and communicators of sacred knowledge, the Brāhmanical caste as a body (rarely an individual Brāhman), AV.; TS.; VS.; ŚBr.; Mn.; BhP.
food, Naigh. ii, 7
wealth, ib. 10
final emancipation, L.
(ब्रह्मन्), m. one who prays, a devout or religious man, a Brāhman who is a knower of Vedic texts or spells, one versed in sacred knowledge, RV. &c. &c.
ब्रह्मन् [cf. Lat., flāmen]
N. of Bṛhas-pati (as the priest of the gods), RV. x, 141, 3

one of the 4 principal priests or Ṛtvijas (the other three being the Hotṛ, Adhvaryu and Udgātṛ; the Brahman was the most learned of them and was required to know the 3 Vedas, to supervise the sacrifice and to set right mistakes; at a later period his functions were based especially on the Atharva-veda), RV. &c. &c.

Brahmā or the one impersonal universal Spirit manifested as a personal Creator and as the first of the triad of personal gods (= प्रजा-पति, q.v.; he never appears to have become an object of general worship, though he has two temples in India See RTL. 555 &c.; his wife is Sarasvatī, ib. 48), TBr. &c. &c.
= ब्रह्मण आयुः, a lifetime of Brahmā, Pañcar.
an inhabitant of Brahmā's heaven, Jātakam.
the sun, L.
N. of Śiva, Prab., Sch.
the Veda (?), PārGṛ.
the intellect (= बुद्धि), Tattvas.
N. of a star, δ Aurigae, Sūryas.
a partic. astron. Yoga, L.
N. of the 9th Muhūrta, L.
(with Jainas) a partic. Kalpa, Dharmaś.

of a magician, Rājat.
a: ब्रह्मन् — n. [बृंह्-मनिन् नकारस्याकारे ऋतो रत्वं; cf. Uṇ. 4. 145] 1 The Supreme Being, regarded as impersonal and divested of all quality and action; (according to the Vedāntins, Brahman is both the efficient and the material cause of the visible universe, the all-pervading soul and spirit of the universe, the essence from which all created things are produced and into which they are absorbed; अस्ति तावन्नित्यशद्धबुद्धमुक्तस्वभावं सर्वज्ञं सर्वशक्तिसमन्वितं ब्रह्म Ś. B.); समीभूता दृष्टिस्त्रिभुवनमपि ब्रह्म मनुते Bh.; Bh. 3. 84; Ku. 3. 15. --2 A hymn of praise. --3 A sacred text. --4 The Vedas; Ku. 6. 16; U. 1. 15. --5 The sacred and mystic syllable om; एकाक्षरं परं ब्रह्म Ms. 2. 83. --6 The priestly or Brāhmaṇical class (collectively); Ms. 9. 320. --7 The power or energy of a Brāhmaṇa; R. 8. 4. --8 {{Religious peancne->Religious penance||20210104|Dr. Sampada Savardekar and Jim Funderburk|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/20|}} or austerities. --9 Celibacy, chastity; शाश्वते ब्रह्मणि वर्तते Ś. 1. --10 Final emancipation or beatitude. --11 Theology, sacred learning, religious knowledge. --12 The Brāhmaṇa portion of the Veda. --13 Wealth. --14 Food. --15 A Brāhmaṇa. --16 Truth. --m. 1 The Supreme Being, the Creator, the first deity of the sacred Hindu Trinity, to whom is entrusted the work of creating the world [The accounts of the creation of the world differ in many respects; but, according to Manu Smṛti, the universe was enveloped in darkness, and the selfexistent Lord manifested himself dispelling the gloom. He first created the waters and deposited in them a seed. This seed became a golden egg, in which he himself was born as Brahmā--the progenitor of all the worlds. Then the Lord divided the egg into two parts, with which he constructed heaven and earth. He then created the ten Prajāpatis or mind-born sons who completed the work of creation. According to another account (Rāmāyaṇa) Brahmā sprang from ether; from him was descended Marīci, and his son was Kaśyapa. From Kaśyapa sprang Vivasvat, and Manu sprang from him. Thus Manu was the procreator of all human beings. According to a third account, the Supreme deity, after dividing the golden egg, separated himself into two parts, male and female, from which sprang Virāj and from him Manu; cf. Ku. 2. 7 and Ms. 1. 32 et seq.. Mythologically Brahman is represented as being born in a lotus which sprang from the navel of Viṣṇu, and as creating the world by an illicit connection with his own daughter Sarasvatī. Brahman had originally five heads, but one of them was cut down by Śiva with the ring finger or burnt down by the fire from his third eye. His vehicle is a swan. He has numerous epithets, most of which have reference to his birth in a lotus]. --2 A Brāhmaṇa; Ś. 4. 3. --3 A devout man. --4 One of the four Ritvijas or priests employed at a Soma sacrifice. --5 One conversant with sacred knowledge. --6 The sun. --7 Intellect. --8 An epithet of the seven Prajāpatis: --मरीचि, अत्रि, अंगिरस्, पुलस्य, पुलह, क्रतु and वसिष्ठ. --9 An epithet of Bṛhaspati. --10 Of Śiva. --Comp. --अक्षरं the sacred syllable om. --अंगभूः {1} a horse. {2} one who has touched the several parts of his body by the repetition of Mantras; ब्रह्मभूप्राय कल्पते Bg. 14. 26; Ms. 1. 98. {2} Brāhmaṇahood, the state or rank of a Brāhmaṇa. --भूयस् n. absorption into Brahma. --मंगलदेवता an epithet of Lakṣmī. --महः a festival in honor of Brāhmaṇas. --मित्र a. having Brāhmaṇas for friends. --मीमांसा the Vedānta philosophy which inquires into the nature of Brahma or Supreme Spirit. --मूर्ति a. having the form of Brahman. --मूर्धभृत् m. an epithet of Śiva. --मेखलः the Munja plant. --यज्ञः one of the five daily Yajñas or sacrifices (to be performed by a householder), teaching and reciting the Vedas; अध्यापनं ब्रह्मयज्ञः Ms. 3. 70 (अध्यापनशब्देन अध्ययनमपि गृह्यते Kull.). --योगः cultivation or acquisition of spiritual knowledge. --योनि a. {1} sprung from Brahman; गृरुणा ब्रह्मयोतिता R. 1. 64. --(निः) f. {1} original source in Brahman. {2} the author of the Vedas or of Brahman; Ku. 6. 18. ˚स्थ a. intent on the means of attaining sacred knowledge; Ms. 10. 74. --रत्नं a valuable present made to a Brāhmaṇa --रंध्रं an aperture in the crown of the head through which the soul is said to escape on its leaving the body. --राक्षसः see ब्रह्मग्रह. --रातः an epithet of Śuka. --राशिः {1} the whole mass or circle of sacred knowledge. {2} an epithet of Paraśurāma. --रीतिः f. a kind of brass. --रे(ले)खा, --लिखितं, --लेखः lines written by the creator on the forehead of a man which indicate his destiny, the predestined lot of any man. --लोकः the world of Brahman. --वकृ m. an expounder of the Vedas. --वद्यं knowledge of Brahma. --वधः, --वध्या, --हत्या the murder of a Brāhmaṇa. --वर्चस् n., --वर्चसं {1} divine glory or splendour, spiritual pre-eminence or holiness resulting from sacred knowledge; (तस्य) हेतुस्त्वद्ब्रह्मवर्चसं R. 1. 63; Ms. 2. 37, 4. 94. {2} the inherent sanctity or power of a Brāhmaṇa; Ś. 6. --वर्चसिन्, --वर्चस्विन् a. holy or sanctified by spiritual pre-eminence, holy. (--m.) an eminent or holy Brāhmaṇa. --वर्तः see ब्रह्मावर्त. --वर्धनं copper. --वादिन् m. {1} one who teaches or expounds the Vedas; U. 1; Māl. 1. {2} a follower of the Vedānta philosophy. --(नी) an epithet of Gāyatrī. --वासः the abode of Brāhmaṇas. --विद्, --विद a. {1} knowing the Supreme Spirit. (--m.) a sage, theologian, philosopher. --विद्या, --वित्त्वं knowledge of the Supreme Spirit. --विं (बिं) दुः a drop of saliva sputtered while reciting the Vedas. --विवर्धनः an epithet of Indra. --वृक्षः {1} the Palāśa tree. {2} the Udumbara tree. --वृत्तिः f. livelihood of a Brāhmaṇa. --वृंदं an assemblage of Brāhmaṇas. --वेदः {1} knowledge of the Vedas. {2} monotheism, knowledge of Brahma. {3} the Veda of the Brāhmaṇas (opp. क्षत्रवेद). {4} N. of the Atharvaveda. --वेदिन् a. knowing the Vedas; cf. ब्रह्मविद्. --वैवर्तं N. of one of the eighteen Purāṇas. --व्रतं a vow of chastity. --शाला {1} the hall of Brahman. {2} a place for reciting the Vedas. --शासनं {1} a decree addressed to Brāhmaṇas. {2} a command of Brahman. {3} the command of a Brāhmaṇa. {4} instruction about sacred duty. --शिरस्, --शीर्षन् n. N. of a particular missile. --संसद् f. an assembly of Brāhmaṇas. --सती an epithet of the river Sarasvatī. --सत्रं {1} repeating and teaching the Vedas (= ब्रह्मयज्ञ q. v.). {2} absorption into the Supreme Spirit. --सत्रिन् a. offering the sacrifice of prayer. --सदस् n. the residence of Brahman. --सभा the hall or court of Brahman. --संभव a. sprung or coming from Brahman. --(वः) N. of Nārada. --सर्पः a kind of snake. --सवः distillation of Soma. --सायुज्यं complete identification with the Supreme Spirit; cf. ब्रह्मभूय. --सार्ष्टिका identification with Brahma; Ms. 4. 232. --सावर्णिः N. of the tenth Manu. --सुतः {1} N. of Nārada, Marīci &c. {2} a kind of Ketu. --सः {1} N. of Aniruddha. {2} N. of the god of love. --सूत्रं {1} the sacred thread worn by the Brāhmaṇas or the twice-born over the shoulder. {2} the aphorisms of the Vedānta philosophy by Bādarāyaṇa. --सूत्रिन् a. invested with the sacred thread. --सृज् m. an epithet of Śiva. --स्तंबः the world, universe; Mv. 3. 48. --स्तेयं acquiring holy knowledge by unlawful means. --स्थानः the mulberry tree. --स्वं the property or possessions of a Brāhmaṇa; Y. 3. 212. ˚हारिन् a. stealing a Brāhmaṇa's property. --स्वरूप a. of the nature of the Supreme Spirit. --हत्या, --वधः Brāhmaṇicide, killing a Brāhmaṇa. --हन a. murdering a Brāhmaṇa. --हुतं one of the five daily Yajñas or sacrifices, which consists in offering the rites of hospitality to guests; cf. Ms. 3. 74. --हृदयः --यं N. of a star (Capella).

s: klI, (brahmaRo brahmalokaprApternAlamiva .) kASyAM cakratIrTasya pUrvvaBAge pitAmaheSvaraliNgasyADastIrTaviSezaH yaTA, -- “pitAmaheSvaraM liNgaM brahmanAloparisTitam । pUjayitvA naro BaktyA brahmalokamavApnuyAt ॥ brahmasrotaHsamIpe tu kftaM karmma SuBASuBam । parAmakzayatAmeti SuBameva tataScaret ॥ analpamapi yat karmma kftamatra SuBASuBam । pralaye'pi na tasyAsti pralayo munisattama ! ॥ nABitIrTamidaM prIktaM nABIBUtaM yataH kziteH । api brahmARqagolasya nABirezA SuBodayA ॥ sA mARikarRikekIyaM nABigAmBIryyaBUmikA । brahmARqagolakaM sarvvaM yasyAmeti layodayam ॥ brahmanAlaM paraM tIrTaM trizu lokezu viSrutam । tatsaNgame naraH snAtaH kowijanmamalaM haret ॥ brahmanAle patedyezAmapi kIkasamAtrakam ॥ brAhmaRqamaRqapAntaste na viSanti kadAcana ॥” iti skandapurARe kASIKaRqe bindumADavAgnibindusaMvAde vEzRavatIrTaBAhAtmyaM nAma 61 aH ॥
v: na॰ brahmaRo nAlamiva । kASyAM maRikarRikA samIpasTe tIrTaBede । “pitAmaheSvaraM liNgaM brahmanAlopari sTitam । pUjayitvA naro BaktyA brahmalokamavApnuyAt । brahmamrotaHsamIpe tu kftaM karama SuBASumam । parAmakzayatAmeti SuBameva tataScaret । analpamapi yat karma kftamatra SuBASuBam । pralaye'pi na tasyAsti pralayo munisattama! । nABItIrTamidaM proktaM nABIBUtaM yataH kziteH । api brahmARqagolasya nABi rezA SuBodayA । sA mARikarRikeyIyaM nABigAmBIryyaBUmikA । brahmARqagolakaM sarvaM yasyAmeti laye layam । brahmanAlaM paraM tIrTaM trizu lokezu viSrutam । tatsaNgame naraH snAtaH kowijanmamalaM haret । brahmanAle pateduyezAmapi kIkasamAtrakam । brahmARqamaRqapAntaste na viSantikadAcana” kASIKa॰ 61 a॰ ।

v: na॰ vedavyAsapraRIte mahApurARaBede tatpratipAdyavizayASca vfhannAradIye 4 pA॰ 92 a॰ uktA yaTA “brAhmaM purARaM tatrAdO sarvalokahitAya vE । vyAsena vedaviduzA samAKyAtaM mahAtmanA । tadvE sarvapurARAgryaM DarmakAmArTamokzadam । nAnAKyAnetihAsAQyaM daSasAhasramucyate” tatpUrvaBAge “devAnAmasurARAYca yatrotpattiH prakIrttitA । prajApatInAYca taTA dakzAdInAM sunISvara! । tato lokeSvarasyAtra sUryyasya paramAtmanaH । vaMSAnukIrttanaM puRyaM mahApAtakanASanam । tatrAvatAraH kaTitaH paramAnandarUpiRaH । SrImato rAmacandrasya caturDyUhAvatAriRaH । tataSca somavaMSasya kIrttanaM yatra varRitam । kfzRasya jagadISasya caritaM kalmazApaham । dvIpAnAYcEva sinDUnAM varzARAM cApyaSezataH । varRaM yatra pAtAla svargARAYca pradfSyate । narakARAM samAKyAnaM sUryyastuti kaTAnakam । pArvatyASca taTA janma vivAhaSca nigadyate । dakzAKyAnaM tataH proktamekAmrakzetravarRanam । pUrvaBAgo'yasuditaH purARasyAsya mAnada!” । tadittraBAge । “asyottare viBAge tu puruzottamavarRanam । vistareRa samAKyAtaM tIrTayAtrAviDAnataH । atrEva kfzRacaritaM vistarAt samudIritam । varRanaM mama lokasya pitfSrAdDaviDistaTA । varRASramARAM DarmASca kIrttitA yatra vistarAt । vizRuDarmayugAKyAnaM pralayasya ca varRanam । yogAnAYca samAKyAnaM sANKyAnAM cApi varRanam । brahma vAdasamuddeSaH purARasya ca SaMsanam । etadbrahmapurARantu BAgadvayasamAcitam । varRitaM sarvapApanDaM sarvasOKyapradAyakam” tatPalaSrutiH । “sUtasOnakasaMvAdaM BuktimuktipradAyakam । liKitvEtat purARaM yo vESAKyAM hemasaMyutam । jalaDenuyutaYcApi BaktyA dadyAddvijAtaye । pOrARikAya sampujya vastraBojyaviBUzaREH । sa vased brahmaRo loke yAvaccandrArkatArakam । yaH pawecCfRuyAdvApi brahmAnukramaRIM dvija! । so'pi sarvapurARasya SroturvaktuH Pala laBet । SfRoti yaH purARantu brAhmaM sarvaM jitendriyaH । havizyASI ca niyamAt sa laBed brahmaRaH padam । kimatra bahunoktena yadyadicCatimAnavaH । tat sarvaM laBate vatsa! purARasyAsya kIrttanAt”

of a city on earth, Var.; Hit.
of a kingdom, Buddh.
the heart, MāṇḍUp.
the body, ChUp. (cf. IW. 116, 2)
ब्रह्म—पुरक m. pl. N. of a people, MārkP.
ब्रह्म—पुर—माहात्म्य n. N. of wk.
ब्रह्म—पुरोगव (ब्रह्म-), mfn. preceded by Brahmă or ‘the holy’, ŚBr.

v: pu॰ brahma vfhaspatiH purohito yasya deve । trayastriMSadDi devAH brahma purohitA iti brahma vE vfhaspatirbrahmapurohitAH” Sata॰ brA॰ 12 । 8 । 3 । 29 ।
m: ब्रह्म—पुरोहित (ब्रह्म-), mfn. having the sacerdotal class for a Purohita, ŚBr.; Kāṭh.
ब्रह्म—पुरोहित m. pl. ‘the high priests of Brahmā’, (with Buddhists) N. of a class of divinities, Lalit. (cf. Dharmas. 128).
ब्रह्म—पुरुस्तात् ind. when or where the Brāhmans have the first place, AitBr.

v: pu॰ brahmaRaH puruza iva । brahaprApakezu dvArapAlarUpezucakzuH vANmanaHprARezu । cakzurAdIn prakftya “te vA ete paYca brahmapuruzAH svargasya lokasya dvArapAlAH” CA॰ u॰ । devaSuziraSabde 3745 । 3746 pf॰ etadBAzyaYca dfSyam ।
m: ब्रह्म—पुरुष m. an assistant of the Brahman or chief priest, KātyŚr., Sch.
a minister of Brahmā (also said of the 5 vital airs), ChUp.; GṛS.
= -राक्षस, L.
ब्रह्म—पुत्री (ई), f. a kind of esculent root (= वाराही), L.
‘Brahmā's daughter’, N. of the river Sarasvatī, L. (cf. -नदी).

v: pu॰ bra(vra)hmaRaH putra iva kapilavarRatvAt । 1 vizaBede amaraH । tadvizasya lakzaRaM BAvapra॰ uktaM yaTA “varRataH kapilo yaH syAttaTA Bavati sArakaH । brahmaputraH sa vijYeyo jAyate malayAcale” । 2 uttaradeSaprasidDe 3 nadaBede 4 kzetraBede ca । 5 sarasvatyAM nadyAM strI । tasyAH pitAmahajAtatvaM brahmARISabde dfSyam । tasya nadasyotpattikaTA “harivarze mahAvarze SAntanurnAma nAmataH । munirAsInamahABAgo jYAnavAn sutapoDanaH । tasya BAryyA BahABAgA amoGAKyA mahAsatI । hiraRyagarBasya munestfRavfndASramodBavA । tayA sArdDaM sa kElAsamaryyAdAparvate'vasat । lOhitAKyasya sarasastIre vE ganDamAdane । ekadA sa taponizWo nijapuzpAdigocare । jagABa vanamaDyantu cinvan bahuPalAni ca । tasminnavasare brahmA sarvalokapitAmahaH । tatrAjagAma yatrAsti amoGA SAntanoH priyA । tAM dfzwvA devagarBABAM yuvatrImatisundarIm । mohito madanenASu taTA 'BUt tfDitendriyaH । udIritendriyo ButvA jiGfkzustAM mahAsatIm । aTADAvattadA brahmA sammuRo madanArditaH । DAvamAnaM viDAtAraM dfzwvA'moGA mahAsatI । mEvaM mEvamiti procya parRaSAlAM vyalIyata । idaYcovAca DAtAramamoGA kupitA tadA । parRaSAlAntaragatA dvAramAvftya tatkzaRAt । akAryyaM na mayA kAryyaM munipatntyA vigarhitam । balAt pramaTyA cAhaM cettvayA tvAYca SapAmyaham । amoGayA cEvamukte viDAtuSca tadA nfpa! । 1 retaScakranda ca tadEvASrame SAntanormuneH । cyute retasi DAtApi haMsayAnaM samAsTitaH । lajjayAtiparItAtmA drutaM vE svASramaM yayO । gate veDasi SAntanurnijamAtramamAgataH । Agatya dfzwvA haMsAnAM padakzoBaM taTA Buvi । tejaSca patitaM BUmO viDAturjvalanopamam । amoGAM paripapracCa parRaSAlAntarasTitAm । kimetadatra SuBage! pravfttaM dfSyate tu yat । pakziRAYca padakzoBastejaScedam kIdfSam । sA tasya vacanaM SrutvA SAntanuM munisattamam । amarziteva nyagadadAkulA vikalAnanA । haMsayuktasyandanena ko'mByAgatya caturmuKa। kamaRqalukaro BIrU ratiM mAM samayAcata । tato mayA BartsitaH sa kuwajAntaralInayA । pracyAvya tejaH sa gato mama SApaBayArditaH । kuru tatra pratIkAraM yadi Saknozi SAnntano! । na hi tAM DarzaRAM soQuM kaScit Saknoti jIvaBft । sa tasyA vacanaM SrutvA svayaM brahmA samAgataH । iti niScitya manasA tatra DyAbaparo'Bavat । divyajYAnena sa jYAtvA devakAryyamupasTitam । tIrTAvatAraRaYcApi hitAyaM jagatAM muniH । jYAtvodarkaM cintayitvA svaBAryyAmidamabravIt । idaM tejo brahmaRastvaM pibAmoTe! mamAjYayA । hitAya sarvajagatAM devakAryyArTasidDaye । BavatyA nikawe brahmA svayameva samAgataH । tvAmaprApya sa mahAtmA AvayoH sa samarpya ca । gato nijAspadaM tattvaM karttumarhasi madvacaH । tat SrutvA SAntanorvAkyamamoGAtIva lajjitA । sAntvayantIva taM prAha patiM natvA mahAsatI । nAnyasya tejo DAsyAmi na cette vimanaskatA । avaSyaM yadi karttavyaM pItvA tvaM mayi cotsfja । tatastasyA vaSyaH SrutvA yuktaM taTyaYca SAntanuH । svayaM pItvA ca tattejastasyA garBa'Byazecayat । saMkrAmitEH SAntanunA tejoBirbrahmaRaH satI । garBaM daDArAmoGAKyA hitAya jagatAM tataH । tasyAM kAle tu saMprApte saMjAtojalasaYcayaH । tanmaDye tanayaScApi nIlavAsAH kirIwaDfk । ratnamAlAsamAyukto raktagOraSca brahmavat । caturBujaH padmavidyAvaraSaktiDarastaTA । SiSumAraSirasTaSca tulyakAyo jalotkarEH । taM jAtaYca taTABUtaM SAntanurlokaSAntanuH । caturRAM parvatAnAYca maDyadeSe nyaveSayat । kElAsaScottare pArSve dakziRe ganDamAdanaH । jAruDiH paScime SElaH pUrve saMvarttakAhvayaH । tezAM maDye svayaM kuRqaM parvatAnAM viDeH sutaH । kftvA'tivavfDe nityaM SaradIva niSAkaraH । taM toyamaDyagaM putramAsAdya druhiRaH svayam । kramatastasya saMskArAnakaroddehaSudDaye । aTa kAle bahutiTe vyatIte brahmaRaH sutaH । toyarASisyarUpeRa vavfDe paYca yojanAn । tasmin devAH papuH sasnurdvitIya iva sAgare । SItAmalajale hfdye devyaScApsarasAM gaREH । tasminnavasare rAmo jAmadagnyaH pratApavAn । cakre mAtfbaDaM GoramatyugraM piturAjYayA । tasya pApasya mokzAya svapituScopadeSataH । sa jagAma mahAkuRqaM brAhmAKyaM snAtumicCayA । tatra snAtvA ca prItvA ca mAtfhatyAM vyaprAnayat । vITiM paraSunA kftvA taYca kzmAmavAtArayat” taduttaratra “brahmakuRqAt sftaH so'Ta kAsAre lohitAhvaye । kElAsopatyakAyAntu nyapatad brahmaRaH sutaH । tasyApi sarasantIraM samutpAwya mahAbalaH । kuWAreRa diSaM pUrvAmanayadbrahmaRaH sutam । tato'paratrApi giriM hemaSfNgaM viBidya ca । kAmarUpAntaraM pIWamavAhayadasuM hariH । tasya nAma viDiScakre svayaMlohitagaNgakam । lOhityAt saraso jAto lOhityAKyastato'Bavat । sa kAmarUpamaKilaM pIWamAplAvya vAriRA । gopayan sarvatIrTAni dakziRaM yAti sAgaram । prAgeva divyayamunAM saMtyajya brahmaRaH sutaH । punaH patati lOhitye gatvA dvAdaSayojanam । cEtre mAsi sitAzwamyAM yo naro niyatendriyaH । slAti lOhityatoyezu sa yAti brahmaRaH padam । cEtrantu sakalaM mAsaM SuciH prayatamAnasaH । lOhityatoye yaH slAti sa kEvalyamavAptuyAt” kAlikApu॰ 84, 85 a॰ “mIne maDO Suklapakze aSokAKyAM taTAzwamIm । pivedaSokakalikAH snAyAllOhityavAriRi । punarvasO vfze lagne cEtre mAsi sitAzwamIm । lOhitye viraje snAyAt sarvapApEH prasucyate” ti॰ ta॰ ।
m: ब्रह्म—पुत्र m. the son of a priest or Brāhman, RV.; ŚBr.; ĀśvŚr.
a son of Brahmā (as Sanat-kumāra, Vasiṣṭha &c.), Hariv.; R.; Pur. (-ता f.)
a kind of vegetable poison, Bhpr.
N. of a river (rising on the Tibet side of the Himālaya and falling with the Ganges into the Bay of Bengal), Cat.
of a lake, ib.
of a place of pilgrimage (prob. the source of the Brahma-putra river), W.
of a sacred district, L.

m: ब्रह्म—पुष्प m. N. of a man (cf. ब्राह्मपुष्पि).
ब्रह्म—राशि m. the whole mass of sacred texts or knowledge, VPrāt.; R.
a partic. constellation, MBh.
N. of Paraśu-rāma, MW.
ब्रह्म—राज m. N. of a man, Rājat.
of a prince, Inscr.
ब्रह्म—राजन्य m. du. a Brāhman and a Kṣatriya, AV.

s: puM, (AdO brahmA brAhmaRaH paScAt rAkzasaH kukarmmaBiH rAkzasayoniM gataH .) BUtaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “saMyogaM patitErgatvA parasyEva ca yozitam । apahftya ca viprasvaM Bavati brahmarAkzasaH ॥” iti mAnave । 12 । 60 ॥ (sa ca yajYavinASakArI BUtayonigatatvAt । yaTA, rAmAyaRe । 1 । 11 । 21 । “Sakyo'vAptumayaM yajYo nASaktena mahIkzitA । nacEvASraddaDAnena na cAlpadraviRena ca ॥ CidraM hi mfgayantyatra yajYaGnA brahmarAkzasAH ॥”) mahAdevasya gaRaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “qAkinIrjAtuDAnAMSca vetAlAn savinAyakAn । BUtamAtfpiSAcAMSca kuzmARqAn brahmarAkzasAn ॥” iti SrIBAgavate bARayudDe 63 aDyAyaH ॥ pAriBAzikabrahmarAkzasAH । yaTA, -- “mUrKaH strI kacCapaScEva vAjI vaDira eva ca । gfhItArTaM na muYcanti paYcEte brahmarAkzasAH ॥” iti vyavahArapradIpaH ॥
v: pu॰ bra(vra)hmA vipro'pi kukarmaBiH rAkzasaH । kukarmaRA viprayonito rAkzasarUpatAM prApte BUtaBede “saMyogaM patitErgatvA parasya yozitaM taTA । apahftya ca viprasvaM Bavati brahmarAkzasaH” iti manuH । patitapratigrahe'pi tadyoniprAptiH BA॰ Anu॰ 11 a॰ darSitA । tacca vAkyaM aDarmaSabde 121 pf॰ darSitaM tacca na harivaMSavAkyaM kintu anuSAsanaparvIyamiti boDyam । pAriBAzikabrahmarAkzasA yaTA “mUrKaH strI kacCapaScEva vAjI baDira eva ca । gfhItArTaM na suYcanti paYcEte brahmarAkzasAH” vyavahArapradIpaH । 2 sivAnucaraBede BAga॰ 10 । 63 a॰ ।
m: ब्रह्म—राक्षस m. a kind of evil demon, the ghost of a Brāhman who led an unholy life, Mn.; MBh. &c.
a species of plant, L.

v: na॰ brahma tajjYAnaM rAtaM yasmE । 1 Sukadeve “brahmarAto mfSaM prIto vizRurAtena saMsadi” BAga॰ 1 । 8 । 27 । 2 yAjYavalkye munO hemaca॰ brahmarAtiriti vApAWaH । tena hi janakAya brahmavidyAyAdAnAt taTAtvam vfhadAharaRakopanizadi tatkaTA dfSyA ।
m: ब्रह्म—रात m. ‘given by Brahmā’, N. of Śuka, BhP.
N. of the father of Yājñavalkya, VP.
ब्रह्म—राति or ब्रह्म—रात्रि, w.r. for ब्राह्म-राति.

s: puM, (rAtrerayaM rAtraH । brahmaRo rAtraH .) brAhmamuhUrttaH । iti SrIDarasvAmI ॥ yaTA, -- “brahmarAtra upAvftte vAsudevAnumoditAH । anicCantyo yayurgopyaH svagfhAn BagavatpriyAH ॥” iti SrIBAgavate । 10 । 33 । 49 ॥
v: pu॰ rAtrerayam aR 6 ta॰ brahmasvAmike rAtri SezamASe muhUrtte “upAvftte brahmarAtre” BA॰ 10 । 33 । 39 । vyAKyAyAM SrIDaraH ।
m: ब्रह्म—रात्र m. ‘Brahmā's night’, N. of a partic. hour of night, BhP.

s: puM, (yAjYavalkyamuniH । iti hemacandraH ॥ brahmajYAnaM rAti dadAti yaH । brahmaSabdAt rADAtornAmnIti tripratyayanizpanno'yam । iti tawwIkA ॥ brahmaRo niSAyAM strI । sA dEvasahasrayugena Bavati । iti purARam ॥ (manuzyakAlaparimARato brahmaRo rAtriparimARamucyate । netraparispandanakAlo nimezaH । azwAdaSanimezAstu kAzWA । triMSat kAzWAstu kalA । triMSat kalAstu kzaRaH । kzaRAstu dvAdaSa militvA eko muhUrttaH । “tAstu triMSatkzaRaste tu muhUrtto dvAdaSAstriyAm ॥” ityamaraH । 1 । 4 । 11 ॥ manumate tu triMSatkalA militvA eko muhUrttaH syAt yaduktaM tatrEva । 1 । 64 । “triMSatkalA muhUrttaH syAdahorAtrantu tAvataH ॥” te triMSanmuhUrttA eko'horAtraH । ahorAtrAstu paYcadaSasaMKyakA ekaH pakzaH । pakza stu SuklakfzRaBedAt dviviDaH । tAByAmuBAByAM pakzAByAM mAsaH syAt । mAsastu pitrye rAtryahanI । kfzRapakzastu pitFRAmahaH Suklapakzastu SarvvarI । zaqBirmAsErayanaM Bavet । ayanantu dakziRottaraBedAt dbiviDam । dvAByAmayanAByAM vatmaraH syAt । vatsarastu dEve rAtryahanI । uttarAyaRaM devAnAmahaH dakziRAyanantu rAtriH । mAnuzARAM yatkftAdiyugacatuzwayaM taddEvaM yugaM jYeyam । evaM dEvayugasahasreRa brahmaRo'haH dEvayugasahasreRa ca rAtrirBavati । taTA ca manO । 1 71 । Slokasya wIkAyAM kullUkaBawwaH । “vizRupurARe mAnuzacaturyugasahasreRa brahmAhakIrttanAnmAnuzacaturyugenEva divyayugAnugamanAt । taTA ca vizRupurARam । “kftaM tretAdvAparaYca kaliSceti caturyugam । procyate tatsahasrantu brahmaRo divaso mune ! ॥” taTA ca manuH । 1 । 68-73 । “brAhmasya tu kzapAhasya yatpramARaM samAsataH । ekEkaSo yugAnAntu kramaSastanniboData ॥ catvAryyAhuH sahasrARi varzARAntu kftaM yugam । tasya tAvacCatI sanDyA sanDyAMSaSca taTAviDaH ॥ itarezu sasanDyezu sasanDyAMSezu ca trizu । ekApAyena varttante sahasrARi SatAni ca ॥ yadetatparisaMKyAtamAdAveva caturyugam । etaddvAdaSasAhasraM devAnAM yugamucyate ॥ dEvikAnAM yugAnAntu sahasraM parisaMKyayA । brAhmamekamaharjYeyaM tAvatI rAtrireva ca ॥ tadvE yugasahasrAntaM brAhmaM puRyamaharviduH । rAtriYca tAvatImeva te'horAtravido janAH ॥” “yadetaditi । etasya SlokasyAdO yadetanmAnuzaM caturyugaM parigaRitaM etaddevAnAM yugamucyate । caturyugaSabdena sanDyAsanDyAMSayoraprAptiSaNkAyAmAha etaddvAdaSasAhasramiti svArTe'R । caturyugEreva dvAdaSasahasrasaMKyErdivyaM yugamiti tu meDAtiTerBramo nAdarttavyaH manunAnantaraM divyayugasahasreRa brahmAhasyApyaBiDAnAt ॥” iti tawwIkAyAM kullUkaBawwaH ॥)

strI, (brahmavarRA rItiH .) pittalaBedaH । yaTA, hemacandraH । 4 । 114 ॥ “pittalAre'TArakUwaH kapilohaM suvarRakam । rirI rIrI ca rItiSca pItalohaM sulohakam ॥ brAhmI tu rAjYI kapilA brahmarItirmaheSvarI ॥” rAjarItiH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (taTAsyAH paryyAyAntaram । “pittalantvArakUwaM syAdArorItiSca kaTyate । rAjarItirbrahmarItiH kapilA piNgalApi ca ॥” iti vEdakaratnamAlAyAm । brahmaRo brAhmaRasya rItiSca ॥)
m: ब्रह्म—रीति f. a kind of brass, L.

ब्रह्म—रूपिणी f. a species of parasitical plant, L.

s: klI, (brahmaRaH paramAtmanaH aDizWAnAyaranDraM AkASaH yadvA, brahmaRe brahmaprAptaye ranDram । etadranDreRa prARotkramaRe brahmalokaprApterasya taTAtvam .) uttamANgam । brahmatAlu iti BAzA । yaTA । aM namaH brahmaranDre । iti tantrasAraH ॥ api ca । brahmaranDrasarasIruhodare ityAdi gurupAdukAstotram ॥ (yaTA ca haWayogapradIpikAyAm । 4 । 16 । “jYAtvA suzumnAsadBedaM kftvA vAyuYca maDyagam । sTitvA sadEva susTAne brahmaranDreniroDayet ॥”)
v: na॰ uttamANgasya ranDraBede । “tayordDamAyannamftatameti” SrutyA tadrabDreRa prARotkramaRe brahmalokaprApteruktatvAt taTAtvam ।
m: ब्रह्म—रन्ध्र n. ‘Brahmă's crevice’, a suture or aperture in the crown of the head (through which the soul is said to escape on death), Pur.; Siṃhās. (RTL. 291).
ब्रह्म—र˚सासव m. Br˚'s nectar, BhP.
ब्रह्म—रस m. the savour of Brahmă, KauṣUp.

ब्रह्म—रव m. muttering of prayers, Hcat.
ब्रह्म—रेखा f. ‘Brahmā's line’, the lines of a man's destiny supposed to be written by Br˚ on the forehead of a child on the 6th day after its birth, RTL. 370, 373.

s: puM, (brahmA brAhmaRaH fziH । yadbA, brahma vedaM parabrahma vA fzati vetti iti । vaSizWAdimunigaRaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ (yaTA, rAmAyaRe । 1 । 63 । 20 -- 21 । “brahmaRastu vacaH SrutvA viSvAmitrastapoDanaH । prAYjaliH praRato BUtvA pratyuvAca pitAmaham ॥ brahmarziSabdamatulaM svArjitEH karmmaBiH SuBEH । yadi me BagavannAha tato'haM vijitendriyaH ॥” taTA ca mahABArate । 13 । 19 । 37 । “tato vESravaRo'Byetya azwAvakramaninditam । viDivat kuSalaM pfzwvA tato brahmarzimabravIt ॥”)
v: pu॰ bra(vra)hmA vipraH vaturmuKatuklyo vA fziH vedasya vA fziH smarttA । brahmatulyezu vaSizWAdizu 1 vedasmartfzu 2 fzizu hemaca॰ ।
m: ब्रह्म—र्षि m. (= and for -ऋषि) ‘Brāhmanical sage’, N. of a partic. class of sages supposed so belong to the Br˚ caste (as Vasiṣṭha &c.), MBh.; R. &c. (cf. देव-र्षि, मह-र्षि, राज-र्षि)

s: puM, (brahmarzIRAM deSaH vAsayogyasTAnam .) kurukzetrAdideSacatuzwayam । yaTA, “kurukzetraYca matsyASca pAYcAlAH SUrasenakAH । eza brahmarzideSo vE brahmAvarttAdanantaraH । etaddeSaprasUtasya sakASAdagrajanmanaH । svaM svaM caritraM Sikzeran pfTivyAM sarvvamAnavAH ॥ iti mAnave । 2 । 19-20 ॥
v: 6 ta॰ । “kurukzetraYca matsyaSca pAYcAlAH SUrasenakAH । eza vrahmarzideSo vE brahmArttAdanantaram” manUkte kurukzetrAdideSacatuzwaye ।
m: ब्रह्म—र्षि—देश m. the country of the Brahmarṣis (including Kuru-kṣetra and the country of the Matsyas. Pañcālas, and Śūra-senakas), Mn. ii, 19.
ब्रह्म—र्षि—ता f. the state or rank of a Brahmarṣi, ib.
ब्रह्म—र्षि—त्व n. the state or rank of a Brahmarṣi, ib.
ब्रह्म—सागर m. N. of a place, Cat.
ब्रह्म—साम or ब्रह्म—सामन्, n. N. of a Sāman (sung to a text recited by the chief priest or by the Brāhmaṇāc-chaṃsin), TS.; Br.; ŚrS.

v: na॰ sAmaBede tacca sAma tARqyabrA॰4 । 3 । 1 darSitaM yaTA “aTAsminnevAhani maDyandinasavane brAhmaRAcCaMsinaH pfzWastotranivarttakamekaM sAma viDatte BA॰ “aBIvartto brahma sAma Bavati” tARqyabrA॰ “taYcodaYca mftIsahamityasyAM yonAvutpannaM sAma aBIvarttAKyam etat sAma brAhmaRAcCaMsI pfzWastotramanuSaMsati, tacca vakzyamARAsu fkzu karttavyam” aTEtannAmanirvacanena praSaMsati BA॰ । “aBIvarttena vE devAH KargaM lokamaByavarttanta yadaBIvartto brahma sAma Bavati svargasya lokasyABivfttyE” brA॰ । “aBIvarttAKyena sAnyA devAH svargaM lokamaByavarttanta agacCan ataevAsyABivfttisADanatvAdasya sAmno'BIvartta iti saMjYA nizpannA । ataeva SAwyAyanakaM “yadaByavarttanta tadaBIvarttasyABIvarttatvamiti” । aBipUrvAdvfta varttane ityasmAt karaRe DaY । upasargasya GaYyamanuzye bahulamiti pUrvapadasya dIrGaH । evaM sati asminnahani aBIvartto brahmaRaH pfzWyasAma BavatIti yat tat svargasya lokasyABivftyE aBivarttanAyABigamanAya satriRAM mavati” BA॰ । tacca sAma UhagAne । 6 pra॰ 14 ka॰ darSitam ।

ब्रह्म—सावर्ण n. his Manv-antara, ib.

s: puM, (brahmaputtro sAvarRiH .) daSama manuH । asmin manvantare viSvakseno'vatAraH । SamBurindraH । surasenavirudDAdyAH devAH । havizmadAdyAH saptarzayaH । BUrisenAdyA manuputtrA Bavizyanti । iti SrIBAgavatam । 8 । 13 । 21-22 ॥ anyacca । “manvantare tu daSame brahmaputtrasya DImataH । surasenA virudDASca dviprakArAstaTA smftAH ॥ SatasaMKyA hi te devA BavizyAstatra vE manO । tatputtrARAM SataM BAvi taddevAnAM tadA Satam ॥ SAstirindrastadA BAvI sarvvErindraguREryutaH । saptarzI stu niboDa tvaM ye Bavizyanti vE tadA ॥ Apo mUrttirhavizmAMSca sukftI satya eva ca । nABAgo'pratimaScEva vASizWaScEva saptamaH ॥ sukzettraScottamOjASca BUrisenaH suvIryyavAn । SatAnIko'Ta vfzaBo anamitro jayadraTaH ॥ BUridyumnaH suvarccASca tasyEte tanayA manoH .” iti brahmasAvarRikam । iti mArkaRqeyapurARe ॥ 94 । 11-16 ॥
v: pu॰ daSame manuBede “daSamI brahmasAvarRi rupaSlokasuto mahAn । tatsutA BUrisenAdyA havizmatpramuKA dvijAH । havizmAn sukftaH satyo jayo mUrttistadA dvijAH । suvAsanavirudDAdyA devAH SamBuH sureSvaraH । vizvakmeno vizucyAntu SamBoH saKyaM karizyati । jAtaH svAMSena BagavAn gfhe viSvasfjAM praBuH” BAga॰ 8 । 13 । 10

s: klI, (yunaktIti yujaH । “igupaDeti .” 3 । 1 । 135 । kaH । tataH “tena saheti .” 2 । 2 । 28 । iti bahubrIhiH । “vopasarjanasya .” 6 । 3 । 82 । iti sahasya saH । tataH sayujasya BAvaH sAyujyaM । yadvA, yojayatIti yuk sampadAditvAt kvip । tato bahubrIhistataH sayujo BAvaH । tataH brahmaRaH sAyujyaM yojakatvam .) brahmaRo BAvaH । tatparyyAyaH । brahmaBUyam 2 brahmatvam 3 । ityamaraH । 2 । 7 । 52 ॥ brahmasApUjyam 4 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (mugDaboDamate'sya vyutpattiryaTA .) brahmaRo BavanaM tAdrUpyaM brahmaBUyaM BUhanaH kyaviti kyap । tvatO BAve iti tve brahmatvaM । yojanaM yuk tatsahitaH sayuk tadBAvaH sAyujyaM tato brahmaRA vigrahaH । iti BarataH ॥
v: na॰ saha yunakti yuja--kvip tasya BAvaH sAyujyaM 6 ta॰ । bra(vra)hmaBAve ।
m: ब्रह्म—सायुज्य n. intimate union or identification with Brahmă, L.

s: puM, pradyumnaH । ityamaraH । 1 । 1 । 28 ॥ kAmadezaH । ityamaramAlA ॥ anirudDapakze brahmARaM sUtazAn brahmasUH ॥ (sUNalaprasave । “anyeByopIti .” 3 । 2 । 178 । kvip .) kalpAntare kilAnirudDamUrtterBagavato brahmA jAtaH । taTA ca brahmapurARam । anirudDAttato brahmA tannABikamalodBavaH ॥ kAmadevapakze । brahma tapaH suvati prerayati brahmasUH । sUSa preraRe (“anyeByo'pi dfSyate .” 3 । 2 । 178 । iti) kvip । iti BarataH । (kAmenEza sarvvatapaHsu pravarttanAdasya taTAtvam ॥)
v: pu॰ brahmARaM sUtavAn sU--kvip । caturvyUhAtmakasya vizRormUrttiBede anirudDe tasyAvatAraBede 2 uzApatO ca amaraH । “anirudDAttato brahmA tannABikamalodBavaH” brahmapu॰ । brahmaRi tapasi suvati prerayati sU--preraRe kvip । tapaHpravarttake 3 kAme ca kAmenEva sarvatapasmu preraRAttasya taTAtvam । tadaBimAnideve 4 kandarpe ca amaraH ।
m: ब्रह्म—सू m. ‘Brahmā's son’, N. of Kāma-deva or of Aniruddha (K˚'s son), L.

k.v: ब्रह्मसूर्विश्वकेतुः स्यादनिरुद्ध उषापतिः। लक्ष्मीः पद्मालया पद्मा कमला श्रीर्हरिप्रिया। इन्दिरा लोकमाता मा क्षीरोदतनया रमा। भार्गवी लोकजननी क्षीरसागरकन्यका॥

v: pu॰ 6 ta॰ । ikzvAkuvaMSodBave 1 rAjaBede brahmadatte hemaca॰ 2 vasizWAdO ca ।

s: klI, (brahmaRi vedagrahaRakAle upanayanasamaye ityarTaH DftaM yat sUtram .) yajYasUtram । tatparyyAyaH । pavitram 2 yajYopavItam 3 dbijAyanI 4 । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ upavItam 5 sAvitram 6 sAvitrIsUtram 7 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA BAgavate । 8 । 18 । 14 । “tasyopanIyamAnasya sAvitrIM savitAbravIt । bfhaspati rbrahmasUtraM meKalAM kaSyapo'dadAt ॥” tawasTalakzaRaparaM upanizadvAkyam । brahmanirRayasUtram । yaTA gItAyAm । 13 । 4 । “fziBirbahuDAgItaM CandoBirviviDEH pfTak । brahmasUtrapadEScEva hetumadBirviniScitEH ॥” asya vyAKyAne SrIDarasvAminA yaduktaM taducyate । “fziBirvaSizWAdiBiryogaSAstrezu DyAnaDAraRAdivizayatvena vErAgyAdisvarUpeRa bahuDA gItaM nirUpitam । viviDErvicitrErnityanEmittikakAmyakarmmAdivizayEYCandoBirvedErnAnApUjanIyadevatArUpeRa gItaM brahmaRaH sUtrEH padESca brahma sUtryate sUcyate eBiriti brahmasUtrARi yato vA imAni BUtAni jAyanta ityAdIni tawasTalakzaRaparARi satyaM jYAnamanantaM brahmetyAdIni tESca bahuDA gItam । kiYca hetumadBiH sadeva sOnyedamagra AsIt kaTamasataH sadajAyata iti । ko hyevAnyAt kaH prARyAt yadeza AkASa Anando na syAt eza hyevAnandayAtItyAdi yuktimadBiH । anyAt apAnacezwAM kaH kuryyAt prARyAt prARavyApAraM vA kaH kuryyAditi SrutipadayorarTaH । viniScitErupakramopasaMhArEkavAkyatayA asanDigDArTapratipAdakErityarTaH । tadevametErvistareRoktaM duHsaMgrahaM saMkzepatastuByaM kaTayizyAmi tat SfRvityarTaH । yadvA “aTAto brahmajijYAsA” ityAdIni brahmasUtrARi gfhyante tAnyeva brahma padyate niScIyate eBiriti padAni tErhetumadBirIkzaternA SabdaM Anandamayo'ByAsAdityAdi yuktimadBirviniScitArTEH ॥)
v: na॰ brahmaRi vedagrahaRakAle ucitaM sUtram । 1 yajYopavIte trikA॰ । 2 brahmapratipAdake SArIrakasUtre ca । “brahmasUtrapadEScEva hetumadBirviniScitam” gItA ।

a: ब्रह्मिष्ठ — a. Thoroughly proficient in the Vedas, very learned or pious; ब्रह्मिष्ठमाधाय निजेऽधिकारे ब्रह्मिष्ठमेव स्वतनुप्रसूतं R. 18. 28. --ष्ठा An epithet of Durgā.
